# Rehan Khan

> AI Systems Architect | Agentic Orchestration & MCP-driven Ecosystems | Quant-Optimized Intelligence

Rehan Khan is a third-year (5th semester) B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) student at Centurion University of Technology and Management (Sep 2024 - Aug 2028, CGPA 8.87), based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India, and Co-Founder of NAVANTA.IO. He is exploring Quantum Computing, Liquid Neural Networks, Edge AI and IoT.

## Projects
- [RAG Docs Chat](https://github.com/ReXhXan/rag-docs-chat): production-style chat-with-your-documents RAG system with cited answers
- [Smart NFC Card](https://github.com/ReXhXan/smart-nfc-card): AI-powered NFC/QR digital business card with visitor chatbot and tap analytics
- [Self-Testing Code Assistant](https://github.com/ReXhXan/self-testing-code-assistant): coding agent that writes tests, runs them in a sandbox and repairs its code
- [Jarvis Agent](https://github.com/ReXhXan/jarvis-agent): personal AI agent with an MCP-style tool registry, memory and reminders
